reached_sql:
SELECT SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_order_number AS wr_order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash AS wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee AS wr_fee,
           wr.wr_reason_sk AS wr_reason_sk,
           cd1.cd_marital_status AS cd1_marital_status,
           cd1.cd_education_status AS cd1_education_status,
           ca.ca_state AS ca_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
        AND ((cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary')
          OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College')
          OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'))
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
        AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
        AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
) AS wr
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1998
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
  AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50.00 AND 300.00
  AND ((wr.cd1_marital_status = 'D' AND wr.cd1_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (wr.cd1_marital_status = 'S' AND wr.cd1_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR (wr.cd1_marital_status = 'U' AND wr.cd1_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00))
  AND ((wr.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR (wr.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
    OR (wr.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250))
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
